description: Implementation of file operations for POSIX systems, including file reading, writing, seeking, locking, and error handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents a file with methods for reading, writing, seeking, locking, and error handling on POSIX systems.

classes.name: File::Info
classes.description: Holds metadata about a file, such as size, timestamps, and type.

methods.name: FromStat
methods.description: Populates file info from a stat struct.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the file handle is valid.

methods.name: GetPlatformFile
methods.description: Returns the underlying platform file handle.

methods.name: TakePlatformFile
methods.description: Releases ownership of the platform file handle.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the file handle.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position in the file.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads data from a specified offset.

methods.name: ReadAtCurrentPos
methods.description: Reads data at the current file position.

methods.name: ReadNoBestEffort
methods.description: Reads data at a specified offset without retries.

methods.name: ReadAtCurrentPosNoBestEffort
methods.description: Reads data at the current position without retries.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes data at a specified offset.

methods.name: WriteAtCurrentPos
methods.description: Writes data at the current position.

methods.name: WriteAtCurrentPosNoBestEffort
methods.description: Writes data at the current position without retries.

methods.name: GetLength
methods.description: Returns the size of the file.

methods.name: SetLength
methods.description: Sets the size of the file.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about the file.

methods.name: Lock
methods.description: Locks the file.

methods.name: Unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the file.

methods.name: Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate of the file handle.

methods.name: OSErrorToFileError
methods.description: Converts errno to a File::Error.

methods.name: DoInitialize
methods.description: Initializes the file with given path and flags.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes buffered data to disk.

methods.name: SetPlatformFile
methods.description: Sets the underlying platform file handle.

methods.name: GetLastFileError
methods.description: Retrieves the last file error based on errno.
